meta.name: art-pipeline
meta.description: Manage game art assets from creation to in-engine. Use when organizing sprites, choosing art tools, setting up folder structures, managing source files, or planning asset production. For a solo dev learning art — practical pipeline, not art instruction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建游戏美术资产管线,从创建到引擎内
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在独立开发游戏,想理清美术素材的管理流程。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a game art asset pipeline from source to engine
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a solo dev who wants to manage game art assets efficiently.

howto.what: Claude 会按 art-pipeline 的技能规范管理游戏美术素材：检查并搭建文件夹结构、按命名规则改文件名、区分源文件和导出文件、估算素材制作时长，并推荐合适的工具。
howto.when: 当你提到整理素材、选择美术工具、规划素材制作等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我建立 art-source 与 assets 的镜像目录结构
say.note: 检查并生成规范目录结构

say.text: 把 Player Idle (2).png 改名为规范格式
按生产时长表估算 30 个敌人精灵的工作量
say.note: 给出按尺寸分级的时间估计

howto.what_en: Claude will apply the art-pipeline convention to game art assets: check/set up folder structure, enforce naming rules, separate source files from exports, estimate asset production time, and recommend tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you organize sprites, choose art tools, or plan asset production.

say_en.text: Set up the mirrored art-source and assets folder structure.
Rename 'Player Idle (2).png' to the standard naming format.
Estimate the workload for 30 enemy sprites using the sizing table.
